mapper.select: SELECT c.chatroom_id, c.name, c.description, COALESCE(mc.member_count, 0) AS member_count, COALESCE(msg.message_count, 0) AS message_count, c.max_members, c.status, c.is_private, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM chatrooms c JOIN chatroom_members cm ON c.chatroom_id = cm.chatroom_id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT chatroom_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM chatroom_members GROUP BY chatroom_id ) mc ON c.chatroom_id = mc.chatroom_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT chatroom_id, COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM chatroom_messages GROUP BY chatroom_id ) msg ON c.chatroom_id = msg.chatroom_id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatrooms c
WHERE c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT c.chatroom_id, c.name, c.description, COALESCE(mc.member_count, 0) AS member_count, COALESCE(msg.message_count, 0) AS message_count, c.max_members, c.status, c.is_private, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM chatrooms c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT chatroom_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM chatroom_members GROUP BY chatroom_id ) mc ON c.chatroom_id = mc.chatroom_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT chatroom_id, COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM chatroom_messages GROUP BY chatroom_id ) msg ON c.chatroom_id = msg.chatroom_id WHERE c.chatroom_id = #{chatroomId}
